structured_output.summary: The change implements Iterator.prototype.includes step by step. The this-check, the skippedElements validation (TypeError, then RangeError for negative or above 2^53-1) with IteratorClose on the placeholder record, GetIteratorDirect, the IteratorStepValue loop, SameValueZero and the final IteratorClose all follow the spec in order. Errors propagate with `?`, and there are no special-cased inputs. Edge cases are handled correctly: NaN is not integral, so it throws a TypeError; -0 is not below -0, so it is allowed; infinities pass the integral check; and an infinite skip count never reaches the 2^53-1 check. I did not run it. The gate reports 88 of 88 test262 runs passing with no regressions. The lint flags are noise.
